name: morbit
hash_encoding: ASCII uppercase decoded text, including recovered word spaces
note: The ACA sheet prints the keyword ranks, Morse pairs, and this literal ciphertext. Its prose plaintext has a final period, but the printed Morse and digit streams omit that punctuation and append one padding divider. The ciphertext's final printed period is explicit framing. Recovered text is ONCE UPON A TIME, including Morse word divisions, with no invented period. This is supplied-key recovery, not unknown-key recovery, an unknown-script reading, or a new historical decipherment.
